Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Review profile, security, and billing events for your own account. Records describe facts and begin when this feature is enabled.
Activity.emptyDescription: Account changes and billing events recorded after this feature is enabled will appear here.
Activity.unavailable: Activity is temporarily unavailable. Please reopen this page later.
Activity.end: All currently available records are shown

account_profile_updated.title: Profile updated
account_profile_updated.description: Your name, email language, or email preference changed.

account_email_changed.title: Account email changed
account_email_changed.description: The account saved a new email address. Activity records do not display the address.

security_email_verified.title: Email confirmed
security_email_verified.description: Email ownership confirmation took effect for your account.

security_email_unverified.title: Email confirmation updated
security_email_unverified.description: The current account email has not completed ownership confirmation.

security_session_created.title: Session established
security_session_created.description: A new account session was created. Registration or email confirmation can also create a session.

billing_checkout_created.title: Payment request created
billing_checkout_created.description: Your account created a payment request. This record does not confirm payment.

billing_payment_confirmed.title: Payment confirmed
billing_payment_confirmed.description: Billing saved valid payment evidence linked to your account.

billing_payment_reversed.title: Payment evidence reversed
billing_payment_reversed.description: Billing recorded a reversal of this payment evidence.

billing_payment_restored.title: Payment evidence restored
billing_payment_restored.description: Billing restored the valid status of this payment evidence.

billing_access_granted.title: Service access granted
billing_access_granted.description: The account saved a service grant linked to valid payment evidence.

billing_access_revoked.title: Service grant revoked
billing_access_revoked.description: The service grant associated with this billing record was revoked.

billing_access_restored.title: Service grant restored
billing_access_restored.description: The service grant associated with this billing record became valid again.
